title: Derp Universe Definition Schemas
description: Comprehensive JSON Schema documenting all 17 definition tables used in Derp Universe. These definitions drive the data-driven game engine and are editable via the admin panel at /admin/def.

ItemType.description: The functional type of an item

ItemRarity.description: Rarity tiers in ascending order: common | uncommon | scare | rare | epic | mythic | legendary | unique

RequirementType.description: Types of requirements that gate access to content

RewardType.description: Types of rewards/effects in outcome blocks

SkipType.description: How skip cost is calculated for timers

GiftRewardType.description: Types of rewards in gift definitions

Stats.description: Entity stat types. ATK/DEF/SPD/FOC/LCK/VIT are the 6 visible stats stored on entities. RND is a hidden resolution directive: when authored in a definition (trait slotStats, effect stats, or scaling weights), RND is resolved to a randomly chosen visible stat at the moment the definition is applied. RND is never stored as a base entity stat, never shown in any UI, and never contributes to PowerScore or Mission Power.

BodySlots.description: Body slot positions for the avian_7 body schema

ModalActionType.description: Discriminant values for ModalAction — determines which fields are present on the action object

ModalBlockType.description: Discriminant values for ModalBlock — determines the block renderer and its fields

ButtonVariant.description: Visual style of a modal button

RichTextNodeType.description: Rich text node types. Block nodes (p, h1, h2, ul, li) contain child nodes. Leaf nodes (text, br, token) carry data. link adds an href field.

PlayerEventType.description: Tracked player event types for telemetry and quest progression

CheckInFrequencyType.description: How often a check-in window opens

EffectCategory.description: What game mechanic the effect modifies (20 categories)

EffectValueMode.description: How the effect value is applied to the base value

EffectStackingRule.description: Behavior when the same EffectDef is applied again to the same target

AudioBus.description: The audio mixing bus that a sound definition belongs to. Controls which volume slider governs the sound.

Timer.description: Duration and skip settings for timed activities (missions, crafting, building)

boostable.description: Whether tick boosts affect this timer

skipable.description: Whether the timer can be skipped for a cost

skip_cost.description: Cost entries to skip (only if skipable=true)

Requirement.description: A single condition that must be met. Structure varies by type.

value-based.description: For types: keeper_level, team_size, flag, trait, building, currency, item

key.description: Identifier key (required for flag, trait, building, currency, item)

operator.description: Comparison operator (optional, defaults to gte for numeric)

ids-based.description: For types: has_building, has_room, parent_has_building, parent_has_room, in_region

ids.description: Array of IDs that satisfy the requirement

Requirements.description: Array of Requirement objects. All must be satisfied (AND logic).

RewardEntry.description: A single reward/effect entry in an outcome block. Structure varies by type.

payload.description: Key-value payload for the event handler

BundleEntry.description: A container grouping multiple reward entries with shared odds and requirements

bundle.description: Nested reward entries (may include nested bundles and bundle_refs)

odds.description: Percentage chance the entire bundle triggers

pickMin.description: Pick mode: minimum number of entries to select from the bundle (uses entry odds as weights)

pickMax.description: Pick mode: maximum number of entries to select from the bundle (uses entry odds as weights)

BundleRefEntry.description: A reference to a saved BundleDef. At resolution time the server inlines the referenced bundle's contents and applies any inline overrides. Behaves exactly like an inline bundle whose entries came from the BundleDef.

type.description: Discriminator — must be the literal string 'bundle_ref'

bundleDefId.description: ID of the referenced BundleDef. Missing or disabled refs resolve to nothing (logged warning).

odds.description: Override the BundleDef's default odds for this usage. If omitted, uses the def's odds (or 100).

pickMin.description: Override the BundleDef's default pickMin for this usage. If omitted, uses the def's pickMin.

pickMax.description: Override the BundleDef's default pickMax for this usage. If omitted, uses the def's pickMax.

requirements.description: Conditions gating this reference (evaluated before expansion)

OutcomeBlock.description: Outcome definition containing a rewards array. Used for mission success/failure.

rewards.description: Array of reward entries, bundles, and/or bundle_refs

CostObject.description: DEPRECATED — Legacy map format. All costs now use the CostEntry array format [{type, id, amount}]. Kept for reference only.

ResourceEntry.description: Canonical resource entry format used in level-based rules

CostEntry.description: Cost entry in level rules (extends ResourceEntry)

ProductionEntry.description: Production rate entry in level rules

StorageEntry.description: Storage capacity entry in level rules

DisplayButtonStateStyle.description: Per-state visual overrides for an inline mission button. All fields are optional; omitting a field falls back to the hardcoded default.

background.description: CSS background value — plain colour or full gradient, e.g. 'linear-gradient(135deg, #3b1fa8, #6d28d9)'

DisplayInlineButtonsStyle.description: Placement and per-state styling for inline mission buttons shown on a Mission Category card.

placement.description: 'inline' (default) — buttons sit beside the card content; 'bottom' — buttons are pushed to the card's bottom edge via flex layout

normal.description: Style when the player can afford the mission

requirementsNotMet.description: Style when the player cannot afford the mission (cost not met)

disabled.description: Style when the button is explicitly disabled

DisplayStyle.description: Visual style overrides stored on a DisplayDef. All sub-objects are optional; missing keys use runtime defaults. The `data._mode` key is a UI-only hint stored by the admin editor (never read by the game engine).

overlay.description: Colour overlay rendered on top of the background image

gradient.description: Raw CSS gradient — overrides color+opacity when set

title.description: Card heading / hero title font overrides

body.description: Body / inline text font overrides (everything else inside the card)

inlineButtons.description: Inline mission button layout and per-state styling (Mission Category cards only)

data.description: Admin-editor UI hints. Currently used keys: `_mode` (string) — the selected editing context ('missionCategory' | 'mission' | 'generic'). Ignored by the game engine.

LevelBlock.description: Configuration for a specific level within level-based rules. Sparse entries inherit downward via resolveLevelConfig().

constructionCost.description: Cost to build/upgrade to this level

LevelRules.description: Top-level rules object with level-based configuration. Uses singular 'level' key containing numbered level blocks.

xpDepositCosts.description: Cost options players may pick from when depositing XP into an instance (LocationDefinition only). Each option spends `amount` of `id` per click and grants `xpPerCharge` XP. Defaults to [{ type:'currency', id:'hard_essence', amount:1, xpPerCharge:1 }] when omitted.

level.description: Map of level number (string key) to LevelBlock. Sparse entries inherit downward.

stats.description: Map of stat name to bonus value

BodySlots.description: Map of body slot to array of allowed archetype names

SlotStats.description: Nested map of body slot to stat bonuses for a trait archetype

EquipmentSlotSchema.description: Map of equipment slot name to max count

GiftPresentation.description: Visual presentation properties for a gift

expiresInSeconds.description: Seconds until gift expires (null = no expiry)

GiftRewardSpec.description: Reward specification for gifts. Structure varies by type. String values in the spec support ${path.to.value} token syntax and ${random("a","b","c")} scripting, resolved against snapshotted contextData at claim time.

definitionId.description: Entity definition ID (ref: EntityDefinition). Supports ${path} token syntax.

overrides.description: Optional overrides applied to the created entity

name.description: Override the entity's display name. Supports ${path} tokens and ${random(...)}.

lootTable.description: Grants a lootbox item to the player's inventory

qty.description: Number of lootbox items to grant

AssetRef.description: Reference to a media asset by key, with optional alt text

assetKey.description: Key used to resolve the asset URL (e.g. via /media/*)

RichTextNode.description: A single node in a rich text document tree. Leaf nodes carry data; block nodes contain children.

block.description: Container nodes: p, h1, h2, ul, li, strong, em, code

token.description: Named placeholder resolved at render time (e.g. player name, entity name)

RichTextDoc.description: An ordered array of RichTextNode objects representing formatted text

RewardItem.description: Display-only reward entry used inside rewardsPreview and rewardsList blocks

ModalTelemetry.description: Optional analytics metadata attached to a modal for tracking display and interaction events

sourceType.description: What triggered the modal (e.g. mission, gift, system)

templateId.description: Template or def ID that produced this modal

ModalAction.description: Action triggered when a modal button is pressed. Discriminated by the 'type' field.

CLOSE_MODAL.description: Dismiss the modal with no side effects

params.description: Route params or query string values

COMPLETE_JOB.description: Complete a job (mission, crafting) and collect its rewards via the command pipeline

CLAIM_GIFT.description: Claim a gift for the player

REPEAT_MISSION.description: Re-launch a mission with the same def and optional entity team

CRAFT_AGAIN.description: Re-submit a crafting job for the same recipe

API_CALL.description: Make an arbitrary API call identified by a stable key

apiKey.description: Stable identifier mapped server-side to an endpoint

payload.description: Arbitrary key-value payload forwarded to the endpoint

ModalButton.description: A button rendered at the bottom of a modal

id.description: Stable button ID for deduplication and telemetry

requiresConfirm.description: If set, tapping this button shows an inline confirmation prompt before executing the action

ModalBlock.description: A single content block rendered in the modal body. Discriminated by the 'type' field. Every block type supports an optional 'from' string property — a dot-path into the server context that auto-populates the block's data fields (e.g. 'results.rewards'). The 'from' field is stripped before the block is sent to the client. All string fields support ${path.to.value} token resolution against the modal context.

from.description: Dot-path into server context. String → wraps as single paragraph. RichTextDoc array → used as doc.
Dot-path into server context (not typically used for divider).

image.description: A full-width image with optional caption

from.description: Dot-path into server context. Object → extracts assetKey/alt/caption. String → used as assetKey.

metaRows.description: A table of label/value pairs (e.g. mission stats, item properties)

from.description: Dot-path into server context. Array → used as rows. Object → entries converted to {label: key, value: String(val)}.

timer.description: Countdown timer block that ticks in real time

endsAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the timer expires

from.description: Dot-path into server context. String → used as endsAt. Object → extracts {endsAt, label?}.
Dot-path into server context. Object → extracts {current, max, label?}.

rewardsPreview.description: Read-only preview of potential rewards (shown before an action)

from.description: Dot-path into server context. Array → each entry mapped via mapRewardItem to populate items.

rewardsList.description: Claimed rewards list (shown after a completed action)

from.description: Dot-path into server context. Array → each entry mapped via mapRewardItem to populate items.

inventoryDelta.description: Shows inventory changes (items added or removed with signed quantities)

from.description: Dot-path into server context. Array → each entry extracts {name, qtyDelta, assetKey?}.

giftReveal.description: Animated gift reveal block showing a gift and its contents

from.description: Dot-path into server context. Object with gift key → merges into gift field and maps rewards. Object with giftId/title → merges directly.
Dot-path into server context. String → used as message. Object → extracts message field.

ModalHeader.description: Header section of a modal containing title, optional subtitle, icon, and banner image

icon.description: Small icon shown beside the title

banner.description: Full-width banner image shown above the title

ModalSpecV1.description: Server-authoritative modal specification (version 1). The backend constructs this object; the frontend renders it declaratively via GameModal. Used for mission results, gift reveals, crafting completion, notifications, and any other game event that requires a rich popup. When used as a ModalDef spec overlay, all string fields support ${path.to.value} token resolution against the server context. The optional 'replaceBody' boolean controls whether the spec body replaces (true) or prepends to (false, default) the server-generated body.

id.description: Stable modal ID used for deduplication in the modal stack

kind.description: Semantic kind (e.g. mission_complete, gift_reveal, generic_info) for telemetry and styling hints

dismiss.description: Controls which gestures can dismiss the modal

body.description: Ordered list of content blocks rendered between the header and the buttons

buttons.description: Action buttons rendered at the bottom of the modal (typically 1–2)

replaceBody.description: When true in a ModalDef spec overlay, the spec body replaces the server-generated body entirely. When false (default), the spec body is prepended before the server body.

EntityResult.description: Per-entity outcome recorded in job results after mission completion. Present in results.entityResults[] on MissionJob jobs.

injured.description: Reserved for future injury system (always false)

TeamEntitySnapshot.description: Entity snapshot included in the JobContext team array for modal template resolution. Fetched at modal-build time from the database.

stats.description: Entity stats object (ATK, DEF, SPD, FOC, LCK, VIT)

CheckInFrequency.description: Controls how often a check-in window opens

interval.description: Used with every_x_days; number of days

CheckInDayReward.description: A reward entry for a specific check-in day

day.description: 0-indexed day in cycle (or 1-indexed — match to streak % cycleLength)

giftDefId.description: GiftDef to issue when this day is claimed

QuestObjective.description: A single objective that must be completed as part of a quest

key.description: If set, also matches PlayerEvent.key. Null = any key

target.description: Total amount needed to complete this objective

dataFilter.description: Optional shallow key-value match against PlayerEvent.data (e.g. {outcome:"success"})

ConsumableEffectSpec.description: A single effect entry in a consumable item's consumableData.effects array

targetType.description: What the effect targets when consumed

ConsumableData.description: Consumable behavior for items with type CONSUMABLE. References EffectDef records for the actual effects. Each effect carries its own targetType — there is no top-level targetType.

effects.description: Array of effect specs applied when the item is consumed

PassiveEffectSpec.description: An inline passive effect entry used in the passiveEffects array on items. Resolved at query time from equipped items — does not create ActiveEffect records.

value.description: Scalar value (used by most value modes)

EffectStatMap.description: Per-stat modifier values. Keys are stat IDs (ATK/DEF/SPD/FOC/LCK/VIT), values are numbers. The special key RND may be a single number or an array of numbers — each element independently picks a random visible stat at resolution time and awards its full point value to it (the same stat may be chosen more than once by chance). RND is stripped from the resolved output and is never stored as an entity stat.

oneOf.description: Single random pick: one randomly chosen visible stat gains this many points
Multiple independent random picks: each element picks its own random visible stat and awards its value. Same stat may be chosen more than once by chance.

RND.description: Random stat award(s). Each value independently picks a random visible stat at resolution time. Serialize as a plain number when only one entry exists (backwards compatible); serialize as an array when there are two or more entries.

Currency.description: Data-driven currency definitions with type, caps, and trade rules

ItemDef.description: Item definitions with rarity, stacking, equipment, consumable, and passive effect metadata

lootboxDefId.description: Reference to a LootboxDef. Required when type is LOOTBOX. Determines the outcome pool when the player opens this item.

passiveEffects.description: Passive effects applied while the item is equipped (resolved at query time, no ActiveEffect records)

EntityDefinition.description: Self-contained character/entity blueprint. Task #367 collapsed BodySchema, EquipmentSchema, ProgressionProfile, TraitDefinition, and NftCollectionDef.data.attributeMap into this record. Task #371 re-introduced structured progression rules: the legacy boolean/int columns (leveling, ascension, mastery, prestigeEligible, maxLevel, ascensionCap, attributeMap) were replaced by four JSON sub-objects — `progression`, `ascension`, `mastery`, and `init` (which holds both `init.scratch` for fresh mints and `init.nft` for NFT-backed builds, including the renamed attributeMap).

traits.description: Per-archetype trait map keyed by archetype name: { archetype: { slotStats, tags, emoji, color, gradient, scaling, rarityMultiplier, rarity } }

progression.description: Progression rules. Shape: { enabled:boolean, maxLevel:int, xpCurve: { kind:'geometric', base:int, ratio:float } | { kind:'table', perLevel:int[] }, statGain: { guaranteed: { ATK,DEF,SPD,FOC,LCK,VIT:int }, bonusPool: { kind:'rarityScaled', base:int, exponent:float, rarityField?:string } | { kind:'flat', amount:int }, distribution: { uniformShare:float, weightedShare:float, weightsField?:string } } }. Required: maxLevel, xpCurve. Defaults reproduce the legacy 50/100*1.15^L curve and 14-pool 50-50 split when fields are present.

ascension.description: Ascension rules. Shape: { enabled:boolean, cap:int, costPerStep?:object, effects?:object[] }. Currently { enabled:false } for all entities — no in-game ascension flow ships yet.

mastery.description: Mastery rules. Shape: { enabled:boolean, branches?:object[] }. Currently { enabled:false } for all entities — no in-game mastery flow ships yet.

init.description: Initialization rules used when minting a new entity. Shape: { baseStats: { ATK,DEF,SPD,FOC,LCK,VIT:int }, scratch: { startingLevel:int, slotFill: { kind:'singleRandomArchetype' } | { kind:'fixed', fixed: { slot: archetype } } }, nft: { attributeMap: { rawNftKey: slotName }, missingSlotPolicy: 'skip'|'error'|'default', defaults: { slot: archetype } } }. baseStats is the shared stat floor applied by both the non-NFT generator and the NFT builder. scratch contains only trait-selection rules (slotFill, startingLevel). The nft.attributeMap was previously stored as a top-level column (#367) and before that on NftCollectionDef.data.

RegionDefinition.description: World regions that locations belong to, with biome and modifier data

id.description: Unique identifier (snake_case, matches DB regionId format)

LocationDefinition.description: Location blueprints with production profiles, level-based rules, buildings/rooms allowance, and requirements

rules.description: Level-based rules (workers, buildings, rooms, storage, production, construction costs)

productionProfile.description: Production profile: outputs[] and inputs[] (ResourceEntry arrays with ratePerHour), optional onStarve (starved|paused), optional enabled boolean

levelUpModalDefId.description: Optional ModalDef whose spec is merged into the auto-generated level-up modal (header/body overrides + replaced buttons). Resolution: server emits a base modal with the new level + a Continue button; if set, the matching ModalDef.spec layers on top via mergeModalDefSpec().

BuildingDef.description: Building blueprints with level-based rules (production, storage, construction costs) and requirements

activeModalDefId.description: ModalDef shown while the building job is running

readyModalDefId.description: ModalDef shown when the building is ready to claim (falls back to activeModalDefId)

completedModalDefId.description: ModalDef shown when the building succeeded

failedModalDefId.description: ModalDef shown when the building failed (falls back to completedModalDefId)

RoomDef.description: Room blueprints (rooms belong to buildings) with level-based rules and requirements

DisplayDef.description: Universal display definitions for visual card styling, referenced by missions and categories

style.description: Overlay, background layout, title & body font overrides, and (for Mission Category cards) inline button placement + per-state styling. The special `data._mode` sub-key is a UI-only hint used by the admin editor to remember the selected editing context; it has no effect on game rendering.

MissionCategoryDef.description: Hierarchical mission categories with display properties, tags, and access requirements

inlineOnly.description: If true, the category is treated as a leaf — players cannot drill into it; its missions can only be launched via inline pills on the parent category card

MissionDef.description: Mission blueprints with success/failure outcomes, timers, difficulty, and requirements

injuryRate.description: Probability modifier for entity injury on mission failure (0.0–1.0). 0 or absent = no injuries. Per-entity chance = D/(TMP+D)*IR where D=difficulty, TMP=total team mission power, IR=injuryRate.

injuryRecoveryTicks.description: Base recovery duration in ticks for injured entities. Actual ticks = base*(1-VIT/(VIT+100)) rounded to nearest integer. 0 or absent = no injuries even if injuryRate>0.

cost.description: Cost entries deducted when the mission starts (see Cost Objects)

inline.description: If true, shows as a quick-launch pill on the parent category card

inlineLabel.description: Custom pill label; defaults to mission duration if omitted

activeModalDefId.description: ModalDef shown while the mission job is running

readyModalDefId.description: ModalDef shown when the mission is ready to claim (falls back to activeModalDefId)

completedModalDefId.description: ModalDef shown when the mission succeeded

failedModalDefId.description: ModalDef shown when the mission failed (falls back to completedModalDefId)

RecipeDef.description: Crafting recipe definitions with costs, timers, rewards, and requirements

cost.description: Crafting cost entries (array of {type, id, amount})

activeModalDefId.description: ModalDef shown while the crafting job is running

readyModalDefId.description: ModalDef shown when the craft is ready to claim (falls back to activeModalDefId)

completedModalDefId.description: ModalDef shown when the craft succeeded

failedModalDefId.description: ModalDef shown when the craft failed (falls back to completedModalDefId)

EventDefinition.description: Server-side event definitions with handler functions and access control

inputSchema.description: Expected payload JSON schema. For the createGiftForPlayer handler, the payload must include giftDefId and may include an optional contextData object. Job source types (MissionJob, CraftingJob, BuildingJob) automatically attach job context via DB lookup.

GiftDef.description: Gift definitions with presentation, claiming rules, and reward specifications

rewardSpec.description: Reward on claim. String values support ${path.to.value} token syntax resolved against snapshotted contextData at claim time. Supports ${random("a","b")} for random selection.

instant.description: If false, claim creates a GIFT_PACKAGE item; player opens via OpenGiftPackage command

LootboxDef.description: Defines a lootbox with weighted outcome pools. Items with type=LOOTBOX reference a LootboxDef via data.lootboxDefId.

iconKey.description: Asset key for the lootbox icon

outcomes.description: Weighted outcome pool (same format as MissionDef rewards). May contain bundles and bundle_refs.

rollCount.description: Number of independent rolls per open

BundleDef.description: Reusable bundle of outcomes that can be referenced by any RewardEntry list via a {type:'bundle_ref', bundleDefId} entry. Lets a single bundle (e.g. 'Starter Pack') be defined once and reused across missions, lootboxes, recipes, gifts, and effects. References may override odds, pickMin, pickMax, and requirements at the call site.

description.description: Optional description of what the bundle contains and when it's used

bundle.description: Outcome entries (same shape as MissionDef rewards / LootboxDef outcomes). May contain nested bundles and bundle_refs.

odds.description: Default odds applied when this bundle is referenced without an inline override

pickMin.description: Default pickMin (entries-to-pick lower bound) applied when not overridden inline

pickMax.description: Default pickMax (entries-to-pick upper bound) applied when not overridden inline

enabled.description: Disabled bundles are skipped at resolution (no entries granted)

CheckInDef.description: Defines a check-in track with per-day gifts and frequency rules. Multiple tracks run independently per player.

cycleLength.description: Streak wraps after this many days

requireStreak.description: If true, missing a window resets streak to 0

allowReclaim.description: If requireStreak=true and streak resets, allow re-claiming day 0 gift

QuestDef.description: Defines a quest with objectives matched against player telemetry events.

objectives.description: List of objectives; all must complete to finish quest

ShopItemDef.description: Defines a purchasable store item. Supports mixed currency/item costs, limited-time availability, and badge labels.

description.description: Short description shown on the card

tab.description: Store tab this item appears on

cost.description: Cost entries (mix of currency and items)

contents.description: What the player receives on purchase

badge.description: Optional label badge (e.g. HOT, NEW, SALE)

imageUrl.description: URL or asset key for the card image

displayOrder.description: Sort order within the tab (lower = first)

limitedUntil.description: ISO 8601 datetime; item hides after this time and shows a countdown

NftCollectionDef.description: Links an on-chain NFT collection to either an EntityDefinition or a LocationDefinition, enabling NFT-gated entity or location claims. Players sync their wallet's NFT holdings against active collections; each matched token creates or transfers the corresponding instance to them. Set entityDefinitionId for character/entity NFTs (requires a pre-import step). Set locationDefinitionId for location NFTs (LocationInstances are created on-demand during wallet sync — no pre-import needed). Exactly one of entityDefinitionId or locationDefinitionId should be set.

collectionId.description: On-chain collection or policy ID used to look up tokens

entityDefinitionId.description: References an EntityDefinition — the entity type created when a token is claimed. Use for character/entity NFT collections. Mutually exclusive with locationDefinitionId.

locationDefinitionId.description: References a LocationDefinition — the location type created when a token is claimed. Use for outpost/location NFT collections (e.g. Derp Outposts). LocationInstances are created on-demand during wallet sync with no pre-import step. Mutually exclusive with entityDefinitionId.

mintMode.description: How many instances one token can claim (currently only one_per_token is supported)

active.description: Whether this collection is currently active for wallet syncing and claiming

data.description: Freeform extra configuration. Supported keys: attributeMap (object) — maps raw NFT attribute key names (case-insensitive) to body schema slot names. Used when a collection's metadata uses prefixed keys (e.g. meta_Body) rather than slot names directly. Multiple raw keys may map to the same slot (e.g. meta_Leader and meta_Multiverse Leader both mapping to leader). Example: { "meta_body": "body", "meta_faction": "faction", "meta_leader": "leader", "meta_multiverse leader": "leader" }

EffectDef.description: Reusable effect blueprints for the Generic Effects System. Effects are universal modifiers that can boost stats, multiply rewards, speed up timers, grant traits, and more.

iconKey.description: Key used to resolve the display icon

stackingRule.description: Behavior when re-applied to the same target

trait.description: Trait archetype name for trait_grant category

durationSec.description: Duration in seconds (for timed duration model)

durationTicks.description: Duration in game ticks (for tick_based duration model)

maxStacks.description: Maximum stack count (for stack_capped stacking rule)

maxUses.description: Number of uses before expiry (for count_based duration model)

resourceId.description: Associated resource ID (for production_rate, storage_capacity, currency_multiplier, cost_discount)

sessionType.description: Session scope key (for session duration model)

enabled.description: Whether this effect definition is active

ActiveEffect.description: Runtime records for currently-active effects applied to targets. Created when a non-instant effect is applied. Not a definition table — this is a runtime/instance table.

userId.description: The player who owns this active effect

targetId.description: ID of the target (player ID, entity ID, etc.)

sourceId.description: ID of the source (item instance ID, mission def ID, etc.)

category.description: Copied from EffectDef at apply time

valueMode.description: Copied from EffectDef at apply time

sessionType.description: Session scope key (for session duration model)

SoundDef.description: Placeholder or real sound file definitions. Each SoundDef represents one audio asset (music track, SFX clip, UI beep, ambient loop). Admins upload files and assign keys; the AudioEngine loads them via /audio/config.

key.description: Unique dot-namespaced action key (e.g. sfx.mission.success, music.main_menu). Used by the AudioEngine to look up sounds.

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the Admin Audio Manager

bus.description: Audio bus assignment: music, sfx, ui, or ambient. Controls which volume slider governs this sound.

fileKey.description: Object storage key for the uploaded audio file (e.g. audio/sfx_mission_success.mp3). null when no file has been uploaded yet.

description.description: Optional notes describing where this sound is used

enabled.description: When false, the AudioEngine ignores this sound definition even if a mapping references it

SoundMapping.description: Maps game action keys to one or more SoundDef entries with optional weights for weighted-random selection. The AudioEngine reads the active mappings at boot via GET /audio/config and resolves a random sound when audioEngine.play(actionKey) is called.

actionKey.description: Game action key (e.g. sfx.mission.success). Multiple mappings with the same actionKey allow weighted-random sound selection.

soundDefId.description: FK to SoundDef.id — the sound to play for this mapping entry

weight.description: Relative weight for weighted-random selection among mappings sharing the same actionKey. Higher weight = higher probability.

enabled.description: When false, this mapping entry is excluded from the audio config response

HomeBannerDef.description: Generic data-driven banner shown at the top of the homescreen. Multiple active banners produce a swipeable carousel; one becomes a single static card. Drives announcements, sales, season info, and event call-outs.

title.description: Big headline shown on the card

backgroundImage.description: Asset key or URL for the card background

ctaLabel.description: CTA button label (blank hides the button)

ctaRoute.description: Route to navigate to on tap (e.g. /missions)

priority.description: Higher priority appears earlier in the carousel

startsAt.description: Banner is hidden before this datetime

endsAt.description: Banner is hidden after this datetime; powers the countdown subtitle

seasonId.description: Optional Season link (substitutes title/endsAt from the Season row when config.deriveFromActiveSeason is true)

config.description: Extra config: { autoAdvanceMs?: number, autoAdvance?: boolean, tagline?: string, deriveFromActiveSeason?: boolean }

GlobalActivePower.description: Time-limited global power modifier activated by admins. Active powers are merged into every player's effect resolution, applying their modifier to all players simultaneously. The tick processor persists status='expired' and broadcasts expiry via SSE.

label.description: Admin-facing label shown in toasts and admin panel

powerType.description: Effect-resolver types map to an EffectCategory; tick_speed_boost acts directly on BoostEvent/TickRateInterval. One of: keeper_xp_boost, entity_xp_boost, mission_power_boost, mission_duration_reduction, crafting_duration_reduction, building_build_duration_reduction, building_upgrade_duration_reduction, injury_recovery_boost, tick_speed_boost

valueMode.description: How the value is applied: percent_add | flat_add | multiplier

scheduledFor.description: Optional future ISO datetime at which the power should automatically activate. If set and in the future, the power is stored with status='scheduled' and activated by the tick processor when this time arrives.

startTime.description: When the power became/becomes active (equals scheduledFor when scheduled, otherwise server now at creation)

status.description: Lifecycle status: active | scheduled | cancelled | expired

triggeredByUserId.description: Admin user ID for audit trail

LocationPowerUsage.description: Tracks per-(location-instance, power-key) daily usage for unique NFT location powers. Enforces a global UTC-day gate so each power can only be triggered once per UTC day regardless of who triggers it.

lastUsedUtcDay.description: UTC date string YYYY-MM-DD of last trigger

usageCount.description: Number of triggers on lastUsedUtcDay; reset to 1 on a new UTC day. Enforced against dailyLimit in the power definition.

TriggerLocationPower.description: Triggers a unique power belonging to a specific NFT location. The caller must own the location (or have admin role). Checks/updates LocationPowerUsage for today's UTC date. All power types (including tick_boost, which is remapped to tick_speed_boost) route through GlobalPowerService.triggerPower.

powerKey.description: The power type to trigger (e.g. tick_speed_boost)

errors: ForbiddenException: caller does not own the location
BadRequestException: no unique powers defined, power key not found, or daily limit reached

boost.changed.description: Broadcast to all connected clients whenever the underlying tick-boost state changes. Emitted by GlobalPowerService when a tick_speed_boost global power is created, cancelled, or expires. Clients update local tick rate from this; toast notifications are driven by global_power.changed instead.

payload.active: Array<{ id, name, percentBoost, endTime }> — current active tick boosts
payload.combinedPercent: number — sum of all active percentBoost values

locationDefinitionUniques.description: The rules JSON on LocationDefinition supports an optional uniques map keyed by NFT asset ID string. Each entry defines per-NFT custom powers that the owner can trigger once per UTC day.

uniques.description: Keys are NFT asset ID strings (e.g. CARDANO:policyId:assetId)

powerType.description: tick_speed_boost | keeper_xp_boost | entity_xp_boost | mission_power_boost | mission_duration_reduction | crafting_duration_reduction | building_build_duration_reduction | building_upgrade_duration_reduction | injury_recovery_boost. Legacy tick_boost is remapped to tick_speed_boost at trigger time.

value.description: For tick_speed_boost: additive percent (50 = +50%). For others: same as GlobalActivePower value.

crossReferences.description: Foreign key relationships between definition tables
